qualityThresholdPercent.label: Photoshoot — quality cut-off
qualityThresholdPercent.help: The combined quality score (garment shape, print legibility, colour match, hand/finger cleanliness, edge quality, seam continuity) a generated candidate must reach before it may enter your review queue at all. 0, as it ships: every candidate reaches you, however it scores — nothing is ever auto-rejected until you set a number.
